visualCharacteristics.purpose: Section title over a row of frosted cards, each crowned by a round seal holding an icon.

contentPattern.structure: Rows with an image = one card (image = seal icon, rest = card text); other rows = section head (heading and intro text).

usage: Brand story or values presented as cards.
reuseGuidance: Reuse story-cards wherever the same content pattern appears; authored content is moved into the block's layout, so keep the structure above.
